why: Records stock losses after `prevStatus` has already moved to the push being recorded (issue #230), so every comparison is a status against itself and no loss is ever found. Every arm then draws no cue at all, the same as the shipped strip, while the flag still reads as set.
killedBy: hud: stock-loss cue arms (issue #230) badge: a "−1" on the entry that lost the stock, and on no other
hud: stock-loss cue arms (issue #230) strike: the old number struck beside the new one
hud: stock-loss cue arms (issue #230) pips: one pip per starting stock, lost ones hollow, and the one just lost carries the cue
